entry_points.text: Looks up or creates classes by key and subclass with origin validation, free-pool allocation into hash and lists, naming and type recording, and subclass caching; serialized with interrupts disabled.
Searches forward or backward from a root for a usage mask, returning traversal outcome and optional match, each direction with its own diagnostic counter.

Gates learning on novel keys with deadlock and predecessor checks under graph hold; try, unchecked, cached, or disabled cases skip. Predecessor walk runs backward in one interrupt context; empty depth or mismatch disables tracking. One configuration always succeeds.

exports.text: Registers dynamic class keys by address hash, rejecting static objects and duplicates, inserting at head for readers under serialization with interrupts saved.
Reports counts of distinct nodes reachable forward from or backward toward a supplied class.
Iterates cached chains to the next in-use slot with negative exhaustion, counts in-use slots, and translates chain positions to classes via compact identifiers.

hazards.text: Exhaustion of classes, entries, chains, or identifier space permanently disables checking with stack diagnostics under emergency protection; singleton fragments leak deliberately and duplicate registration warns once.

Queue exhaustion advises larger queue bits while other errors report numeric codes; reporting may suppress silently, abort on failed stack capture, or flag malformed paths; aliasing, missing keys, asymmetry, and key divergence signal corruption with held-versus-cached comparison.

invariants.text: Classes live in exactly one of global, free, or zap lists; dependency entries must back-reference owners with usage flags matching reachability; chain keys must equal iterative combination from an initial value, else diagnostics.

Cache probes unlocked then locked to avoid duplicates, checks aliasing on hit with distinct hit/miss outcomes; a debug check rebuilds keys from the held stack resetting on interrupt change and disables tracking on divergence.

Edge strength encodes four read-mode combinations with separate forward/backward forms and a weak-only flag; matching needs same class with read accepting any marking while other modes reject exclusive-only stores.

Dependency lists are reached by displacement from class base, after for forward and before for backward; entries allocate by first clear usage bit and store owner, target, strength, distance, and trace.

Static keys as dynamic warn once; disabled checking assumes dynamic; buckets hash key address; full validation runs at most once when enabled with an empty alternate; circular reporting honors silent mode.

Usage merge and lookup use full masks except interrupt-only on exclusive-read-only edges; traversal keeps ordinary locks, conditionally per-CPU, skips other flavors; masks toggle direction and plain/read forms with pair search and read-table naming; one configuration disables both.

Tallies start at zero counting every visited node; redundancy seeks sufficient-strength existing paths seeded by source mode while skipping a lightweight family, with one configuration never matching; forbidden prior usage is refused after releasing graph.

Identifier blocks come from a shared array via size buckets with oversize ordered separately, exact then variable with splitting then larger, minimum two units threaded in-array; insertion records the interrupt slice plus new entry with miss and per-context counts preferring hard over soft over process.

Reports show kernel and task identity, lock details, dependency direction, reverse chains, parent walks with depth and malformed checks, three-node summaries, two-CPU interleavings by flavor, per-node class info with traces and key identity, and stepwise key expansion.
List, RCU hash, bitmap search, address hashing, interrupt save/restore checks, per-CPU iteration, interrupt counters, and continuation logging helpers are used here but specified elsewhere.

locks.text: Graph and chain mutation holds the graph lock with interrupts disabled, acquired after unlocked probe and held across validation, while iteration uses read-side protection and statistics need disabled interrupts when checking; reporters disable debug locks with graph release and bracket output in an emergency section.

state_machines.text: Tracking initializes at most once with separate flags; deferred handling waits for scheduling while general init prepares zap lists, free pool, dependency lists, and chain storage; an alternate build has empty bucket preparation.

Search uses a fixed queue with front/rear and generation-based visitation; forward or backward walks apply caller skip and match predicates, suppress weak-only paths, record first match and peak occupancy, and report match, no match, exhaustion, or invalid node.

Path checks delegate to forward search; cycle checks count attempts and choose recursive versus circular reporting by class equality; interrupt checks succeed unless backward safe and forward unsafe locks narrow to an incompatible pair.

Deadlock checks report detected, safe, or nesting-serialised skip; predecessor checks report failure on circularity, misuse, allocation, or asymmetry, strengthening on present edges, or acceptance for new, redundant, ordered, or keyless cases.

structs.text: Queue capacity is two to a configurable bit count with mask one less; outcomes encode invalid as minus two, full as minus one, match as zero, no match as one, negatives as errors.

Chains use a fixed table with key, context, depth, base, linkage, and use bitmap; identifiers share a narrow array with reclaimed, free, lost, and oversize counts; the size directory has sixteen entries with bit-fifteen flag and all-ones terminator.
